g.text: French door · Hinge left · opens outward · plan, outside below

svg.text: Frame 68×93, land 47, rebate 21 on the exterior; leaf 57, gap 4; glass 24mm 6x12x6
Meeting stiles 100, lip 6 past the centre line, half lapped; active leaf on the exterior
Mullion M1, M2 68×93: rebate 21 each side of the land 26, the leaf 13 + gap 4 from the axis
Side lights: casement fixed lights, stiles 64×57 in the exterior rebate, never open
Rebate drawn as deep as the leaf (flush with the face it opens to), glass centred in the leaf
